first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so a guarded simplification test can address the two linked problems without relying on retention-damaging discounts. Verify the prior onboarding result and its complex-workspace churn risk, plus activation messaging as the strongest alternative. Exclude complex-workspace accounts pending verification.

final.rationale: Run an in-product activation-messaging experiment. The verified result directly matches the 6% activation decline, previously delivered +6% activation and +11% week-one engagement, and showed a modest +1% improvement in 30-day retention. This offers the strongest sustainable-value profile for the single slot. Shortened onboarding would improve completion but requires segment exclusions due to confirmed churn harm in complex-workspace accounts. Measure qualified revenue and longer-term retention because the prior messaging evidence extends only through 30-day retention.
